Dosing in Cohort 2 has been completed, and we expect to report topline data in the first quarter of 2027, including 3 month data for Cohort 2 participants and 6 month data for the three Cohort 1 participants with BVMD.

We intend to advance our current active pipeline and may explore opportunities to out-license from our portfolio or in-license other drug candidates.
